services.title: Tree Felling & Removal
services.desc: Safe, controlled removal of large or hazardous trees. We manage the entire process—felling, chipping, and removal—leaving your garden clear and ready.

services.title: Tree Pruning & Maintenance
services.desc: Expert crown lifting, thinning, and shaping to improve light, health, and aesthetics. Keeps trees strong and prevents future problems.

services.title: Storm Damage & Emergency Response
services.desc: Broken branches or fallen trees threatening your property? We respond quickly to make safe and restore your garden.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Reduction
services.desc: Regular hedge work or one-off reductions to open up views and keep boundaries tidy. Fully chipped and removed on the day.

services.title: Stump Grinding & Removal
services.desc: Grind out old stumps completely or dig roots out for full removal. Leaves your garden flat and ready for replanting or paving.

services.title: Dead Wood Clearance
services.desc: Safely remove dead, diseased, or dangerous branches from living trees. Protects your property and improves tree vitality.

about_pullquote: We treat every tree like it belongs to someone we care about.
about_para_1: RSH Tree Services started in Sheffield over 15 years ago with a simple belief: tree work should be done right, safely, and without the inflated bills. We've grown from a one-man operation to a trusted name across South Yorkshire, handling everything from routine garden pruning to complex felling operations. Every job is carried out to industry standards and backed by full insurance.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on turning up on time, doing the job properly, and leaving your garden spotless. We specialise in the trees other contractors won't touch—whether that's a dangerous limb hanging over your house or a massive oak that needs careful removal. Customers return to us because we listen, explain what needs doing, and never oversell unnecessary work.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a massive oak leaning over the garage after the storms. Rang RSH and they were out the next morning. Really professional—felled it safely, chipped everything, and left the garden cleaner than before. Brilliant job, fair price, would use again no question.
reviews.author: Mike T.

reviews.text: Our hedge was completely out of control, blocking the light from the kitchen. Dave came round, gave us a sensible quote, and the work was done in a day. Tidy lads, no mess left behind. Couldn't be happier with the result.
reviews.author: Susan M.

reviews.text: Emergency call after the tree came down on the fence. They turned up within hours, made everything safe, and sorted the fallen wood. Professional, friendly, and honest about what needed doing. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: James K.
